operations.description: Requires control.upgrades.check in a platform scope. The decision re-verifies the locally cached signed entitlement lease, checks its release channel and version range, then evaluates the current locally cached signed platform policy. The license service is not called by this request. Business denials return 200 with eligible=false and a stable reason; authentication, validation, and idempotency failures retain their normal HTTP status. An identical idempotent replay returns the original decision without appending another audit event.

fields.name: current_version
fields.description: Canonical SemVer without a v prefix or build metadata.

responses.description: Eligible or a stable business denial based only on verified local state.

fields.name: reason
fields.type: string: eligible / entitlement_unavailable / entitlement_invalid / entitlement_state_denied / entitlement_channel_mismatch / entitlement_version_denied / platform_policy_stale / release_channel_denied
